title: Imagining his old teacher's reaction
summary: He lists the major halls he has played and imagines the teacher's face.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: But as I sit here now, I'd just like to see if that man that charged me twenty-five cents a lesson...I'd like to see his eyes open if they told him that I played at BBC in London and CBS in New York and NBC, and Swiss television and French television and the Olympia in Paris and the Salle Gevaux and the Salle Pleyel and the Fair de Paris and concerts in Gobr and Amsterdam, and Carnegie Hall in New York and the Academy of Music in Philadelphia and Town Hall in New York. I'd just like to see what the expression on his face would be like, and what he would say. I imagine it would be something like, 'Well, sometimes kids have hidden talents. (Laughter). Sometimes it's latent and it don't come out... it don't come out (you know )soon.'
